posts.description: Today in “the only thing that matters is money”: Jenson Huang has been reinstated. Pay attention, children. We were wrong to ever condemn Donald Trump. Power and money, kids, will give you everything you ever wanted. Principles are for losers.

Now that The Visitor’s News issue one is with readers, it’s time to start thinking about issue two. The deadline for issue two letters is December 10th . Please assume a week of travel time for letters sent through the mail. All subscribers are encouraged to send in a letter!
One of the great blessings of being a sticker is experiencing a living landscape .
